json.notes: Oval white arena: a stepped drum with a lower brick-clad base, a white paneled shell, and a high flat oval roof set inside a lower roof terrace ring. The front (south, -z) has a tall glazed curved facade under a large sweeping white canopy/roof overhang, with chrome spheres on the plaza. I model the bowl shell as stacked ovals, the central roof disc, the glass front wedge with a canopy slab, and the spheres.
